query:
update tournaments
              set name = $2, format = $3, status = $4, start_date = $5,
                  end_date = $6, capacity = $7, roster_size = $8, credit_grant = $9,
                  current_round = $10, swaps_per_round = $11, swap_window_open = $12,
                  roles_enabled = $13
            where id = $1
